visual.general_description: Five-panel composite: intraoperative eye photographs for two cases (A and B), two line charts of rabbit corneal thickness after antiseptic instillation (C and D) and a six-time-point photograph series of a rabbit eye (E).
visual.detailed_description: A composite figure with panel letters A to E. Panels A and B at the left are 2 by 2 grids of blue-tinted surgical photographs labelled "Right" and "Left" showing intraoperative views and post-lens-implantation views. Panels C and D at the right are line charts of corneal thickness in micrometers over time after instillation of test solutions, and panel E below them is a six-photograph series of an eye labelled Baseline, 5 min, 10 min, 30 min, 1 hr and 2 hr.

panels.general_description: Intraoperative photographs of the right and left eyes of case 1 during nucleus removal (top row) and after lens implantation (bottom row).
panels.detailed_description: Four close-up color photographs in a 2 by 2 grid. The top row shows blue-tinted intraoperative views of the "Right" and "Left" eyes with instruments in the field, and the left eye image appears softer and more uniformly grey-blue. The bottom row shows the "Right" and "Left" eyes with a tan-brown round lens optic centered in the pupil area and bright light reflections.

imaging_modalities.visual_cue: Magnified color photographs of the eye taken during and after surgery

evidence.quote: Intraoperative corneal haziness
Central corneal haziness is markedly more evident in the left eye compared to the right eye.
(A) Case 1 and (B) case 2. The top row shows intraoperative views during nucleus removal in the right and left eyes, respectively.
Central corneal haziness is markedly more evident in the left eye compared to the right eye.
The bottom row shows post–intraocular lens implantation views of the right and left eyes, respectively.

pixel_observations: The panel is a 2 by 2 grid of four square photographs with the letter A at the upper left; each photograph carries the printed word "Right" or "Left" at its upper right.

Top row: blue-tinted magnified views of an eye with surgical instruments in the field; in the "Right" image a slender rod enters from the left edge and a pale flat-tipped instrument rises from the lower center, and the "Left" image shows a pale instrument tip rising from the lower center.
In the top row the "Left" image looks more uniformly grey-blue and softer in detail than the "Right" image; four small bright light reflections sit near the center of each.

Bottom row: a round tan-brown lens optic fills the pupil area in each photograph, with bright light reflections on it; the "Left" image shows a speckled bright patch at the center and a short vertical row of reflections below it, and the "Right" image shows a few separated reflections and a small dark mark on the optic.
No scale bar, ruler or other printed text is visible beyond the panel letter and the Right and Left labels.

caption_claims.value: Caption states that case 1: the top row shows intraoperative views during nucleus removal of the right and left eyes, central corneal haziness is markedly more evident in the left eye, and in the bottom row (after intraocular lens implantation) the haziness in the left eye has resolved. These are author statements, not measurements from the image.

evidence.quote: Central corneal haziness is markedly more evident in the left eye compared to the right eye.
The previously noted corneal haziness in the left eye has resolved.

clinical_significance.statement: The authors present the panel as documenting intraoperative corneal haziness in the second eye of the case and its resolution after intraocular lens implantation.

evidence.quote: The previously noted corneal haziness in the left eye has resolved.

limitations: Haziness is judged from a still photograph with different instrument positions and lighting between images, so the degree of corneal clarity is not measured from pixels.
Resolution of the haziness stated in the caption is not independently verified from the bottom-row images.

panels.general_description: Six close-up photographs of a rabbit eye labelled by time after alcohol instillation, with a pink central pupil area enlarging and paling.
panels.detailed_description: Six close-up color photographs in two rows of three with the letter E at the upper left. Printed time labels are Baseline, 5 min and 10 min above the top row and 30 min, 1 hr and 2 hr below the bottom row. Each photograph shows an eye with a brown-pink iris and a pink to red circular area in the pupil. From Baseline to 1 hr the central area enlarges and becomes paler and whiter; at 2 hr it remains enlarged but is pinker than at 1 hr. The 1 hr photograph shows fine dark speckles over the pale area and the 2 hr photograph shows small white irregular marks. A small bright light reflection appears in most images.
